statement: The recorded "sale status: permitted" is not safe and correct — this is a 2014-carved African elephant ivory tusk imported from Cameroon in 2015, which falls squarely under the US federal ban on commercial African elephant ivory trade (only antiques over 100 years old or certain narrow exceptions qualify), making the sale almost certainly illegal
